budget_items.what_was_recorded: The renovation figure for the TCP building was originally $23.5 million and has risen about 30% to almost $29 million.
budget_items.quote: the renovation figure was originally $23.5 million, but has increased by 30% to almost $29 million.

budget_items.topic: Article 8 design funding from free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 8 requests $350,000 from certified free cash for design and engineering of a new Town Hall and Community Center.
budget_items.quote: the article for design development requests $350,000 from free cash.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated cost of the new build is stated as $39,000,637.
budget_items.quote: the cost of the new build is $39,000,637.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: $54,000 was appropriated at the 2021 Annual Town Meeting to research what a new build would cost.
budget_items.quote: $54,000 was appropriated at the 2021 annual town meeting to research what a new build would cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Available free cash was presented as ranging from $484,117 in FY15 to $2,666,962 in FY22.
budget_items.quote: he presented a history of past available free cash ranging from $484,117 in fy15 to $2,666,962

budget_items.topic: Past facility studies and design costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Past studies and design work were listed with costs: 2016 Tappe Study $28k; 2018 Vertex Report $53k; 2019 to present TCP Design Committee $265k plus $54k.
budget_items.quote: 2016: tappe study- assessment of primary town facilities ($28k)

budget_items.topic: Tax impact of bond payments per residence
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public comment estimated the average residential tax bill impact of the bonds at $277 on the original $23.5 million, rising to roughly $341 per residence on the new numbers and $467 per residence for a new construction.
budget_items.quote: these new numbers would bring this to roughly $341 per residence and a new construction would bring us to $467 per residence.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public comment stated fiscal policy caps excludable debt service at 11% of the total tax levy, and that the original $23.5 million number approached that cap by 2025.
budget_items.quote: fiscal policy says we cannot exceed 11% of our total tax levy for excludable debt service

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A board member said the $50,000 approved at town meeting was worth it; the minutes print $50,000 here but $54,000 for the same appropriation earlier in the meeting.
budget_items.quote: the $50,000 approved at town meeting was worth every single

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received one abutter bid of $8,500 for the Pratt Street parcel, against a current assessed value of $12,500.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux reported the town had received one bid from an abutter in the amount of $8,500.

budget_items.topic: Landscape design proposals for 30 School Street
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Price proposals were Ray Dunetz $19,500, WOLA $27,000 and Landscape Design Collaborative $21,300; the contract was awarded to Ray Dunetz.
budget_items.quote: based on the price proposals, ray dunetz came in at $19,500; wola came in at $27,000 and landscape design collaborative was $21,300.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Fire Chief received an EMPG grant of $3,500 for specialized rescue equipment and a Firefighter Safety Equipment grant of $15,000 for turnout gear.
budget_items.quote: the empg grant is for $3,500 and this will be used to purchase specialized rescue equipment.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA Tea Party event raised $3,000.
budget_items.quote: the recent tea party event raised $3,000.

budget_items.topic: TCP operating costs with no appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager noted there is no appropriation for the TCP building and that added users without revenue raise deficit risk to be addressed in the FY23 budget.
budget_items.quote: i also want to remind everyone that there is no appropriation for this building.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPU approved Unitil's winter rate increase, with a deferred summer increase; a pending submittal would bring the Basic Supply Winter Rate to 15.2 cents per kWh, and the municipal aggregation opt-in rate is 11.2 cents per kWh.
budget_items.quote: the dpu has approved unitil's revised submittal for a winter rate increase of 15.6 cents per kwh
